name: use-railway
tagline_zh: 不用再在文档和 CLI 之间来回切。建项目、开数据库、绑域名、看指标、查故障，一个 Skill 全包。
tagline_en: Stop alt-tabbing docs and CLI. Projects, DBs, domains, metrics, feature flags, troubleshooting — all inside one.
desc_en: Operate Railway infrastructure: sign up for or sign in to a Railway account, create projects, provision services and databases, manage object storage buckets, deploy code, configure infrastructure as code, environments and variables, manage domains, troubleshoot failures, check status and metrics, manage feature flags, set up Railway agent tooling, and query Railway docs. Use this skill whenever t
why_zh: 把 Railway 的 API 和文档揉成一套动作，省去你记命令和翻页。适合把基建当工具。
why_en: It wraps Railway's API and docs into one flow, so you don't memorize commands or hunt for pages. For builders, not ops teams.
limit_zh: 只认 Railway 一家，不碰 AWS/GCP/Vercel。需要你有 Railway 账号或能现场注册。
limit_en: Railway-only; no AWS/GCP/Vercel. Needs your Railway account or signup. Won't handle billing, support tickets, or architecture design.
title_en: One-skill Railway operator: signup to logs, no tab-hopping
